recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is; no FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless a future issue changes ImplementationGuide global/default-profile search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17306 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request asking to restore the ImplementationGuide resource search parameter for included definition resources and to add a global search parameter for globally applicable profiles.
initial_application: The Jira application comment records SVN revision 13948. Git history maps that to b2ac2fe9e5efd5e51b623412cd3ab9e86044c06b, "GF#17306 - add search parameters on implementation guide", which added resource as ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.reference and global as ImplementationGuide.global.profile in the then-authoritative ImplementationGuide spreadsheet source.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/implementationguide/bundle-ImplementationGuide-search-params.xml defines ImplementationGuide-global on ImplementationGuide.global.profile and ImplementationGuide-resource on ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.reference. The expression differs from the issue's older global.resource wording because current ImplementationGuide.global is modeled with type/profile. A same-day Zulip reporter thread confirms the intended scope, and Confluence/exact-key searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The published audit commit records that current source already satisfies the final Jira decision using current element names.
